claim: The number of substructure patterns in the dictionary used for featurisation.
locus_a: Experimental Section, Feature Extraction: 'The SMARTS list of substructure patterns is predefined as a substructure dictionary, comprising 881 molecular substructures.'
locus_b: Results, ML Performance: 'The occurrence counts of each of the 307 substructure fingerprints (FP1 to FP307) were used as input features' -- and the feature total of 314 only reconciles with 307 (307 fingerprints + N/P + mass ratio + 5 molar ratios = 314).
what_we_emitted: nothing -- no emitted value depends on it
why: 881 is the PubChem substructure key length; 307 is PaDEL's substructure fingerprint, which is what the paper says it used. The 314-feature arithmetic in the same paragraph only works with 307, so 881 is the stray number.

claim: Which supplementary table holds the fingerprint dictionary.
locus_a: Experimental Section, Feature Extraction: 'FP12 and FP169 represent alcohol and phenol, respectively, as listed in Table S2'.
locus_b: Results, ML Performance: '...307 substructure fingerprints (FP1 to FP307) ... (Table S1)'. The SI's Table S1 IS the fingerprint dictionary; Table S2 is the LNP composition table.
what_we_emitted: nothing -- a citation error, not a data error
why: Recorded because a reader following the Methods citation lands on the composition table and finds no FP numbers at all.

claim: The SMARTS patterns printed for FP1 and FP2 in Table S1.
locus_a: SI Table S1: FP1 'Primary carbon' = [CX4H1][#6]; FP2 'Secondary carbon' = [CX4H1]([#6])[#6]; FP3 'Tertiary carbon' = [CX4H1]([#6])([#6])[#6].
locus_b: The cited source (ref 17 and the openbabel SMARTS_InteLigand.txt URL in the reference list) defines Primary_carbon as [CX4H3][#6] and Secondary_carbon as [CX4H2]([#6])[#6].
what_we_emitted: FP3's standard pattern [CX4H1]([#6])([#6])[#6] is used in 07_qc.json's connectivity check; FP1 and FP2 are not used for anything emitted
why: As printed, FP1 and FP2 both demand exactly one hydrogen, so 'primary carbon' would match no CH3 at all and FP2 would be indistinguishable from FP3 in hydrogen count. It is a transcription slip in the table, not in the analysis -- Figure 2b's FP3 counts (2 and 3) are exactly what the STANDARD tertiary-carbon pattern gives for these lipids, which is how we know the analysis used the standard definitions.

claim: The age of the ICR mice used for the I.D. RLuc and I.M. hEPO measurements.
locus_a: SI Figure S2 caption: 'Seven-week-old ICR mice were immunized...'
locus_b: Experimental Section, Animal Experiments: 'Six-week-old female ICR mice (n = 3) were obtained from Daehan Biolink and used for luciferase activity and hEPO expression measurements.'
what_we_emitted: nothing -- the schema has no field for animal age
why: The Methods statement is specific to these two measurements and also gives sex and n; the caption gives neither. Neither is emitted, so no value depends on the choice.

claim: The injection volume for the I.D. RLuc experiment.
locus_a: SI Figure S2 caption: '5 ug/40 uL of LNPs'.
locus_b: Experimental Section, RLuc Assay: '5 ug/20 uL'; and Figure S2's own panel a, drawn above that caption, is labelled 'R/L mRNA-LNP 5ug / 20ul'.
why: Two independent loci say 20 uL and one says 40 uL, and one of the two is the figure the caption is describing. The DOSE is 5 ug in all three, and dose is the only one of the two quantities the schema carries, so no emitted value is affected.

claim: The mouse strain used for the HPV immunisation experiments.
locus_a: SI Figure S4 caption: 'Mice (seven-week-old C57BL/6) prime/boost immunized with LNPs encapsulating HPV mRNA'.
locus_b: Experimental Section, Animal Experiments: 'BALB/c mice were used for immunization experiments.'
what_we_emitted: nothing -- the immunisation panels are not emitted at all (DECISIONS.md D-3)
why: Recorded because it bears on the decision: the vaccine readouts cannot be given a Model_type until the strain is settled, which is one more reason they are a separate experiment and not pooled with the ICR expression screen.

locus_a: Figure 2b x-axis: 'Number of Tails (Ts) (FP3)', with groups at 2 and 3.
locus_b: SI Table S1: FP3 is 'Tertiary carbon'. Every member of this library has exactly TWO tails; the third branch point counted at FP3 = 3 is FH-1's own branched acyl head, which the paper classifies as a functional head and not a tail.
what_we_emitted: the FP3 = 2 / 3 split is used as a connectivity assertion in 07_qc.json; the axis LABEL is not used
why: The underlying count is right and the label is wrong. It matters because FP3 = 3 identifies the FH-1 LNPs, which is the only route from a printed statistic to a connectivity check on our enumeration -- and 'number of tails' would have pointed at the wrong structural feature.

claim: The carbon length of the tails.
locus_a: Results, ML Performance: 'The numbers of carbon atoms in the EB can range from 5 to 12, whereas the T carbon length ranges from 1 to 2.'
locus_b: SI 1.2.2 and Figure 3a: T-1 is 2-hexyldecyl (16 carbons) and T-2 is 2-octyldodecyl (20 carbons).
what_we_emitted: T-1 and T-2 are emitted as their measured 16- and 20-carbon structures
why: 'T carbon length ranges from 1 to 2' reads the identifier T-1/T-2 as a carbon count. This is the project's documented 'name tokens are not chain lengths' hazard appearing in the source text itself. The EB tokens DO equal the backbone carbon count (checked: chains.check_name_token matches for EB-5/6/7); the T tokens do not.

claim: What Figure S2 panels b and d show.
locus_a: SI Figure S2 caption: 'b-e, Relative RLuc expression levels according to LNP type.'
locus_b: The panels themselves: b and d are pie charts titled 'Molar ratio of LNP type 1' and 'Molar ratio of LNP type 4'; only c and e are expression heatmaps.
what_we_emitted: values taken from panels c and e only
why: Recorded because the caption would lead a reader to treat four panels as expression data. The pie charts are what PIN each heatmap to an LNP type of Table S2, which is a separate and useful role.

claim: The label of the second functional head.
locus_a: Figure 3a and Figure 4d draw it as 'FH2'.
locus_b: Figure 3c, Figure 4b, Figure 4f, Table S3 and all running text write 'FH-2'.
why: Cosmetic, but recorded: a join on the label as drawn would split one head into two.

claim: How many ionizable lipids the study covers.
locus_a: Results and Experimental Section, repeatedly: '213 LNPs', '14 types of FHs', '14 types of EB-T chains'.
locus_b: Figure 3a is the only place any functional head, ester bridge or tail is drawn, and it draws 6 heads, 3 bridges and 2 tails. Figure S1 shows only a generic scaffold with R1 and R2.
what_we_emitted: 36 structures -- the full 6 x 3 x 2 of Figure 3a -- and no structure for the remaining library
why: 213 is a count of LNP FORMULATIONS, not of lipids: Figure 2's nine printed group sizes partition 213 across the six compositions of Table S2 (76/25/26/76/3/7) and all nine partitions reconcile. The 14 x 14 block set that would give the distinct lipids is drawn nowhere, so 177 of the 213 LNPs have no recoverable structure. See DECISIONS.md D-1.
